programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: All Happy Gilmore (Adam Sandler) has ever wanted is to be a professional hockey player. But he soon discovers he may actually have a talent for playing an entirely different sport: golf. Meanwhile, Danny struggles to prepare for the high pressure Caddy Day golf tournament while absorbing New Age advice from wealthy golf guru Ty Webb (Chevy Chase).

programme.title: Days of Thunder

With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes).

programme.title: White House Down

Not wanting to disappoint his young daughter with the bad news, Cale takes her on a tour of the White House. While he and his daughter are there, a heavily armed paramilitary group attacks and seizes control. As the nation's government dissolves in chaos, only Cale can save his daughter, the president and the country.

programme.title: The Office
programme.desc: This U.S. adaptation -- set at a paper company based in Scranton, Pa. -- has a similar documentary style to that of the Ricky Gervais-led British original. It features the Dunder-Mifflin staff, which includes characters based on roles in the British show -- and, quite possibly, people with whom you work in your office. There's Jim, the likable employee who's a bit of an every man. Jim has a thing for receptionist-turned-sales-rep Pam -- because office romances are always a good idea! There's also Dwight, the co-worker who is successful but devoid of social skills and common sense.

It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains.

Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jimmy Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice.

Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. programme.title: College Football

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: California at Louisville The Golden Bears play the No. 15 Cardinals for the first time. Louisville won its third straight game Nov. 1 when it took care of Virginia Tech, 28-16 on the road. California's Kendrick Raphael has scored six touchdowns across his past two games.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: North Carolina at California The Tar Heels (2-3, 0-1 ACC) try to right the ship when they face the Golden Bears (4-2, 1-1). Bill Belichick's first conference game at the helm of North Carolina was one to forget, as Dabo Swinney's Clemson dismantled the Tar Heels 38-10 on Oct. 4.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Georgia Tech at NC State The Wolfpack (4-4, 1-3 ACC) field a challenge from the undefeated No. 8 Yellow Jackets (8-0, 5-0) in Week 10. Georgia Tech picked up a 30-29 home victory over NC State last season. The Yellow Jackets are 8-0 for the first time since 1966.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Alabama at Florida State The Seminoles put 2024 in the rearview during this opener against the No. 8 Crimson Tide. Florida State went a forgettable 2-10 last year. Alabama turns to Ty Simpson at quarterback after Jalen Milroe was drafted by the NFL's Seattle Seahawks.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: SMU at California The No. 21 Mustangs try to secure a berth in the ACC title game as they visit the Golden Bears. SMU has won six of its past seven and controls its fate as championship weekend looms. Kevin Jennings (SMU) created nine TDs in his last three games.

programme.desc: Duke at Clemson The Tigers (3-4, 2-3 ACC) and Blue Devils (4-3, 3-1) return from the bye. In 2023, Duke snapped a five-game series slide with its first victory over Clemson since 2004. Duke's three-game win streak was snapped by undefeated Georgia Tech on Oct. 18.

programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part One (1930-1959) Adolph Rupp comes to the University of Kentucky in 1930, two years before the SEC is formed, and his Wildcats go on to dominate play in the conference for decades. Meanwhile, a future coaching legend later known as Pat Summitt is born in Tennessee.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Two (1960-1970) Texas Western's historic win over Adolph Rupp's Kentucky team in the 1966 NCAA final marks a turning point in the SEC. Vanderbilt's Perry Wallace becomes the conference's first Black player, while at LSU, Pete Maravich rewrites the record books.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Three (1971-1979) Dale Brown brings an infectious personality to LSU while Pat Summitt begins her legendary coaching career at Tennessee. And the year after Adolph Rupp's death in 1977, his successor Joe B. Hall leads Kentucky to its first NCAA title in 20 years.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Four (1980-1989) Georgia's Dominique Wilkins and Auburn's Charles Barkley headline the SEC's successes in the early 1980s, while LSU's Dale Brown takes two teams to the Final Four. Pat Summitt wins her first two national titles at Tennessee.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Five (1990-1998) Arkansas joins the SEC and becomes one of the conference's top teams, led by fiery coach Nolan Richardson and his "40 Minutes of Hell" attack. Kentucky returns to prominence, and at Tennessee, Pat Summitt wins three straight NCAA titles.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Six (1998-2010) In his first year at Kentucky, Tubby Smith becomes the third Black coach ever to win a national title. Florida's back-to-back NCAA crowns mark the rise of a new power. The Lady Vols win 2 straight NCAA titles as LSU reaches 5 straight Final Fours.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Seven (2011-2022) John Calipari continues the winning tradition at Kentucky with a national championship in 2012. Four years later, Pat Summitt passes away after battling early-onset Alzheimer's disease. Dawn Staley leads South Carolina to a pair of NCAA titles.

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Blood Alley The CIA asks Kane and his team to take down a high-level gang boss involved in human smuggling, but Kane's investigation uncovers a larger conspiracy involving organ-trafficking.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Violence of Action After a Mexican drug cartel's cash shipment is hijacked, Kane sees that a former CIA associate may be involved in the heist.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: S02 E08 — Angel of Death As Kane gets ever-closer to The Ghost, he lets Finch go into the field but is unsure if she is willing to do whatever it takes.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: S02 E10 — Dead Drop Kane knows that his hidden nemesis The Ghost is now closer than ever; Kane continues to track the suitcase nukes, but now suspects that his contact inside the CIA may be working against him; Kane tries to stop the nukes from reaching buyers.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: One Shot One Life Kane has an opportunity to take revenge for the lives of his colleagues, but the FBI has taken notice of his handiwork and intervenes.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Medical students (Kiefer Sutherland, Julia Roberts, Kevin Bacon) play with death by stopping one another's vital signs for minutes, then zapping the subject back to consciousness.

programme.title: Solo
programme.desc: A robot soldier (Mario Van Peebles) goes AWOL to avoid reprogramming, then helps Mexican villagers defeat rebels.

programme.title: Blood Crime
programme.desc: A policeman discovers that the man he beat up, the son of a sheriff (James Caan), was later murdered.

programme.title: The Hunt for Eagle One
programme.desc: A lieutenant (Mark Dacascos) leads his men in a daring mission to rescue a captain (Theresa Randle) who is trapped behind enemy lines.

programme.title: The Hunt for Eagle One: Crash Point
programme.desc: Marines venture into enemy territory to retrieve an anti-hijacking device stolen by terrorists.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Rival teenage boxers (Cuba Gooding Jr., James Marshall) rise above racism and a vile promoter (Brian Dennehy) of rabble-rousing underground bouts.

programme.title: The Poker Club
programme.desc: Four poker players (Johnathon Schaech, Johnny Messner) land in hot water when they kill an intruder and then try to dispose of the body.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Top Coolest Movie Characters A countdown of the top coolest movie characters.

programme.title: Planet Action
programme.desc: A look at how celebrities are stepping up to make a difference in the world and hopefully inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: The Scarlet and the Black
programme.desc: Defying a Nazi colonel (Christopher Plummer), Vatican Monsignor Hugh O'Flaherty (Gregory Peck) hides thousands of escaped POWs in occupied Rome.

programme.title: The Desperadoes
programme.desc: An outlaw (Glenn Ford) blamed for a bank robbery helps a Utah sheriff (Randolph Scott) catch the real culprits.

programme.title: The Texican
programme.desc: A fugitive lawman (Audie Murphy) leaves Mexico to get the Texas saloon boss (Broderick Crawford) who framed him and killed his brother.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: A Texas woman (Lillian Gish) and her eldest son (Burt Lancaster) fight Kiowas over an adopted daughter (Audrey Hepburn).

programme.title: Decision at Sundown
programme.desc: A gunman (Randolph Scott) rides into Sundown for a showdown with the big shot (John Carroll) he blames for stealing his wife.

programme.title: The Nebraskan
programme.desc: War looms on the horizon when an Army officer's American Indian aide is accused of murdering a tribal elder.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie; however, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

programme.title: The Evil That Men Do
programme.desc: A hit man leaves retirement to stop a British torturer serving the regime in Guatemala.

programme.title: Hard Times
programme.desc: A gambler (James Coburn) backs a bare-knuckle brawler (Charles Bronson) in Depression-era New Orleans.

programme.title: Hanover Street
programme.desc: A U.S. bomber pilot (Harrison Ford) goes on a secret World War II mission with his English lover's (Lesley-Anne Down) husband (Christopher Plummer).

programme.title: Relentless
programme.desc: Los Angeles police detectives (Robert Loggia, Leo Rossi) track the so-called Sunset Killer (Judd Nelson), who taunts them with messages.

programme.title: Deadly Illusion
programme.desc: A private eye (Billy Dee Williams) hired to kill a man's wife (Morgan Fairchild) warns her instead and then finds both are impostors.

programme.title: Jack Reed: One of Our Own
programme.desc: Framed for his partner's murder, Sgt. Jack Reed embarks on a quest to bring those responsible to justice.

programme.title: Jack Reed: Death and Vengeance
programme.desc: A Chicago police detective links the murders of immigrants to a Russian con artist, not a local labor dispute.

programme.title: Planet Action
programme.desc: S05 E05 A look at how celebrities are stepping up to make a difference in the world and hopefully inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: The Desperate Mission
programme.desc: A Mexican outlaw/folk hero (Ricardo Montalban) and his men agree to bring a land baron's wife to 1840s San Francisco.

programme.title: Mercenary
programme.desc: An electronics mogul (John Ritter) coerces a former commander (Olivier Gruner) into helping him find the terrorist who killed his wife.

programme.title: The Principal
programme.desc: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

programme.title: Rio Diablo
programme.desc: An Old West bounty hunter (Kenny Rogers) goes after a gang of bank robbers who have kidnapped his new partner's (Travis Tritt) bride.

programme.title: Black Fox
programme.desc: A white homesteader's black blood brother is sent to negotiate the release of their families from their Indian captors.

programme.title: Black Fox: The Price of Peace
programme.desc: In the 1860s Texas, a man whose abused wife fell in love with a Kiowa organizes a hunting party to recapture her.

programme.title: Seraphim Falls
programme.desc: In 1868 a determined hunter (Liam Neeson) and four hired gunmen relentlessly pursue an injured man (Pierce Brosnan) across Nevada.

programme.title: The Net
programme.desc: Software allowing Internet access to classified government files makes a computer nerd (Sandra Bullock) the target of a British hacker's (Jeremy Northam) criminal organization.

programme.title: Panic Room
programme.desc: A divorced woman and her diabetic daughter take refuge in their newly-purchased house's safe room when three men break in, searching for a missing fortune.

programme.title: Love Lies Bleeding
programme.desc: A corrupt DEA agent (Christian Slater) chases a young couple (Jenna Dewan, Brian Geraghty) who are in possession of money from a botched drug deal.

programme.title: Borderline
programme.desc: After his release from prison, a man (Sean Patrick Flanery) implicates his psychiatrist (Gina Gershon) in a murderous plot.

programme.title: The Nines
programme.desc: An actor is under house arrest, a TV show chronicles a sitcom production, and a video-game designer and his family become stranded in the woods.

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: An oilman (Albert Dekker) and a cowboy (John Wayne) become boom-town rivals for a schoolmarm (Martha Scott) and Oklahoma oil.

programme.title: Comanche Station
programme.desc: Three outlaws join a loner (Randolph Scott) and another man's wife (Nancy Gates), who was kidnapped by Indians.

programme.title: The Art of War
programme.desc: Underground after being accused of murdering a Chinese ambassador, a security expert (Wesley Snipes) comes out of hiding when terrorists threaten the United Nations.

programme.title: The Art of War II: Betrayal
programme.desc: After agent Neil Shaw is brought out of retirement, he finds himself in the middle of a conspiracy fingering him in a recent murder.

programme.title: Sniper: Legacy
programme.desc: After several military leaders are assassinated, Brandon (Chad Michael Collins) hears his father (Tom Berenger) was one of the people killed. As he hunts the killers, Brandon learns his father is not dead, and he is being used as bait.

programme.title: The Death and Life of Bobby Z
programme.desc: Tim Kearney (Paul Walker), a former Marine in prison, is asked to impersonate a recently killed drug lord to get out of his sentence. When a hostage switch with a crime lord goes badly, Tim goes on the run with the drug lord's son.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stuntman who moonlights as a getaway driver for thieves finds that a price has been put on his head after a failed robbery.

programme.title: Sunset

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S02 E04 — Roasted Goose and Striped Bass Chef Zimmern cooks his version of Peking-style goose. Next, Chef Zimmern cooks a meal of striped bass.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Venison and Duck Gumbo Chef Andrew Zimmern grills his favorite tender cuts of venison and serves it with coal-roasted sweet potatoes. Then, he cooks a hearty pot of classic Louisiana gumbo using wild duck and grills crispy-skinned duck breast for the topping.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S02 E01 — Boar Ribs and Shrimp and Grits Chef Andrew Zimmern makes a homemade barbecue rub, basting sauce and barbecue sauce for wild boar ribs. Next, chef shares his twist on a classic southern shrimp and grits recipe, adding a side of beautiful wild mushrooms.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
